label: Launch target
text:
Launch target
Open from the app icon
Main screen
Web

Applies the next time you open DSHA from the app icon. With Web selected, the icon shows a loading screen and opens Web once it is ready; going back from the first Web page returns to the home screen. Maintenance or startup failures still open the main screen.

Disabling dsh-launch-target keeps the selected launch target.
